description: [Migawari] Request an instant total quote for a physical task in Japan: shopping proxy (including limited-edition and in-store-only items), in-store stock checks, on-site photo capture, restaurant phone reservations in Japanese, queueing / standing in line, package forwarding, registry certificate retrieval (a certified company registry certificate from the Legal Affairs Bureau; give the company name and/or 13-digit corporate number in details, plus certificate_type and copies if not the defaults), or real estate registry documents (certified land/building registry certificates, registry maps and filed survey/building drawings from the Legal Affairs Bureau; give the property address and/or lot number in details, plus documents or document_types if not the default). The total is itemised (item price + quote fee JPY 2,200 + handling fee + shipping). Requesting a quote is free: the quote fee (JPY 2,200) is charged as part of the total when you accept, and is non-refundable once charged. Getting a quote does not reserve execution: accepting a quote only places the request in pending_review. The response includes an access_token shown only once: store it, it authorises accept/decline/status/evidence/messages for this quote.

certificate_type.description: For registry_certificate: which certificate to obtain. full_history = 履歴事項全部証明書 (default), current = 現在事項証明書, representative = 代表者事項証明書.

copies.description: For registry_certificate: number of certified copies (default 1, max 20). The government issuance fee (JPY 520 per copy) is charged at cost as the quote's item price. For real_estate_registry: shared copies per document when document_types is used (default 1, max 20).

currency.description: USD totals use the FX rate fixed at quote time.

details.description: Service-specific details: store name/address, target items, photo subjects, restaurant name + party size + desired time (phone_reservation; venue_type must be 'restaurant'), queue location, package sender/destination, company_name and/or corporate_number (registry_certificate; the 13-digit 法人番号 identifies the company unambiguously), property_address and/or lot_number / house_number (real_estate_registry; the operator resolves the lot number from the address when only the address is given), etc.

document_types.description: For real_estate_registry: simpler alternative to documents — the document types to obtain, each with the shared copies count. Default: ["land_certificate"].

documents.description: For real_estate_registry: the documents to obtain, each with a type and optional copies (default 1, max 20 per document, max 10 entries). Issuance fees at cost: JPY 520 per registry certificate, JPY 470 per map or drawing.

type.description: land_certificate = 土地の登記事項証明書, building_certificate = 建物の登記事項証明書, closed_certificate = 閉鎖事項証明書 (for closed registry records; paper-era records can take one to two weeks), map = 地図証明書（公図）, survey_drawing = 地積測量図・建物図面.

item_price_jpy.description: Alternative to items[]: total item price, tax incl., JPY.

requester.description: Who is asking: agent name and a contact the operator can reply to.

shipping_jpy.description: Optional shipping override in JPY; defaults apply otherwise.

test_mode.description: If true, this is a test order: the flow is simulated and no payment is requested.

name: migawari__request_quote
title: Request a quote
